findings: The least-squares representative solves delta^T delta x = delta^T b by conjugate gradient with mean-centring.
Line, triangle, and two-glued-triangle exact cochains give zero obstruction and recover the centred source.
A triangle with nonzero cycle sum reports a nonzero harmonic class with delta^T h equal to zero.
Bad tolerance, bad iteration limit, bad cochain width, and bad edge endpoints are explicit errors.
